#Q3: trait correlations

Question: How strongly are the species parameters associated with critical plant traits related to drought tolerance and access to water: Leaf Dry Matter Content (LDMC), water potential at 50% loss of conductivity (Ψ50), osmotic potential at turgor loss point (πTLP), and rooting depth?.

Set up data:

```{r, warning = F}
#read in trait df.
#Data is mean from TRY, 
traits_df <- read_csv(here("data", "traits_rd_20250327.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(
         # SWC dropped: for saturated leaves SWC = 1/LDMC - 1, so it is redundant with LDMC
         sla_calc = 1/lma
         ) #%>% 
  # mutate(sla = case_when(
  #   sla > 20 ~ NA, 
  #   TRUE ~ as.numeric(sla)
  # ))

# Psi-min: EVT estimate (0.99 quantile, floored at the lowest reading) from script 04;
# lowest observed value for species with too few tail points
psi_min_df <- read_csv(here::here("data", "psi_min_by_species.csv")) %>%
  select(species, psi_min_evt = psi_min)

q3_df1 <- read_csv(here::here("data", "concept_df.csv")) %>%
  select(1:15) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  left_join(psi_min_df, by = "species") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(min_lfm = min(lfm, na.rm = T),
         max_lfm = max(lfm, na.rm = T),
         min_wp = psi_min_evt,
         max_wp = max(mwp, na.rm = T),
         min_ilfm = 1/min_lfm, 
         intercept_lfm = 1/intercept,
         maxlfm_minwp = -1*min_wp + max_lfm
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(group == "species") %>% 
  merge(traits_df, all = T)

#read in predawn data:
pds_q3_df_raw <- read_csv(here('data', 'all-data-combined-predawns.csv')) %>% 
  clean_names() 

pds_q3_df <- pds_q3_df_raw %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  filter(time %in% "pd") %>% 
  mutate(min_pd = min(wp, na.rm = T),
         max_pd = max(wp, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  select(-wp, -date, -lfm, -x1, -tissue_age, -sp_site) %>% 
  distinct()

#add in predawns:
q3_df <- merge(q3_df1, pds_q3_df, by = c("species", "study"), all = T) %>% 
  #select(-study, -study_nice, -sp_site, -tissue_age, -time, -mwp_z) %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  fill(c("min_pd", "max_pd"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
  #only keep the trait data and model summaries we are interested in: 
  select(species:slope, min_lfm:max_pd, -study,-time) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()

q3_df %>% write_csv(here("data", "q3_df.csv"))

q3_df_salvias <- q3_df %>% filter(species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL"))
q3_df_outs    <- q3_df %>% filter(!(species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")))
```

How closely are observed min mpas matched to published means?

```{r observed_vs_published, warning = F}
# observed min. MD and published (TRY) min. MD, one row per species
obs_vs_pub <- q3_df %>%
  distinct(species, min_wp, psimin_md) %>%
  filter(!is.na(min_wp), !is.na(psimin_md))

# shared x/y range so the panel is square
pub_lims <- range(c(obs_vs_pub$min_wp, obs_vs_pub$psimin_md))

figS6_obs_vs_pub <- ggplot(obs_vs_pub, aes(y = min_wp,
             x = psimin_md,
             color= species)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  coord_equal(xlim = pub_lims, ylim = pub_lims) +
  labs(y = "Estimated Ψmin (EVT; MPa)",
       x = "Published Ψmin (TRY; MPa)",
       color = "Species") +
  color_species +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13))

figS6_obs_vs_pub

ggsave(plot = figS6_obs_vs_pub, here::here("output", "figures", "SI", "Fig_S06_observed_vs_published_psi_min.jpg"), dpi = 600,
       height = 6,
       width = 7.5, units = "in")

cor.test(obs_vs_pub$min_wp, obs_vs_pub$psimin_md)
```



#Fig SX: Traitcorrelations

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ----------------------------
# Pick vars
# ----------------------------
model_params <- c("min_lfm", "max_lfm", "intercept_lfm", "slope", "min_wp")

traits <- c("plc50_stem", "psi_tlp", "ldmc", "sla")

vars_use <- c(model_params, traits)

# ----------------------------
# Nice labels (edit however you want)
# ----------------------------
nice_names <- c(
  # model parameters
  min_lfm        = "LFMmin",
  max_lfm        = "Max. observed LFM",
  intercept_lfm  = "LFMmax",
  slope          = "Slope",
  min_wp         = "Ψmin",
 # maxlfm_minwp   = "Max LFM @ Min Ψ",

  # traits
  plc50_stem     = "P50",
  psi_tlp        = "ΨTLP",
  ldmc           = "LDMC",
  sla            = "SLA"
 # min_pd         = "Min Ψpd"
)

# ----------------------------
# Helper: pairwise cor.test p-values (handles NAs per pair)
# ----------------------------
pairwise_cor_p <- function(df, x_vars, y_vars, method = "pearson") {
  out <- expand.grid(x = x_vars, y = y_vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      n = sum(is.finite(df[[x]]) & is.finite(df[[y]])),
      test = list({
        xx <- df[[x]]
        yy <- df[[y]]
        ok <- is.finite(xx) & is.finite(yy)
        if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NULL)  # too few points
        suppressWarnings(cor.test(xx[ok], yy[ok], method = method))
      }),
      r = if (is.null(test)) NA_real_ else unname(test$estimate),
      p = if (is.null(test)) NA_real_ else test$p.value
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(x, y, n, r, p)

  out
}


#With the salvias: 

# ----------------------------
# Build plotting df
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- q3_df %>%
  select(all_of(vars_use)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  { pairwise_cor_p(., x_vars = model_params, y_vars = traits, method = "pearson") } %>%
  mutate(
    x_lab = nice_names[x],
    y_lab = nice_names[y],
    # stars for quick significance reading
    stars = case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ "",
      p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    # label shown in each tile: p-value + stars
    label = case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ paste0("p=", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3), "\n", stars)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_lab = factor(x_lab, levels = nice_names[model_params]),
    y_lab = factor(y_lab, levels = rev(nice_names[traits]))  # reverse so first trait is top row
  )

# ----------------------------
# Plot: traits (rows) × model params (cols)
# ----------------------------
p_corr <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2c2c2c", mid = "white", high = "#b22222",
    limits = c(-1, 1), oob = squish, name = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "figures", "SI", "Fig_S10_trait_param_correlation.jpeg"),
  plot = p_corr,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)
```

#Fig SX. P50 + TLP and model params - all salvia

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig 7: A–D with equal-size panels and a dedicated legend column
#
# Layout (all panels SAME SIZE):
#   Col 1: A (top), B (mid), C (bottom)   [x = P50, flipped]
#   Col 2: Legend (top spanning A+B), blank (mid), D (bottom) [x = ΨTLP, flipped]
#
# Requests implemented:
#  - ALL PANELS same size (C and D are same size; D matches A/B/C)
#  - Legend slightly bigger; plots slightly smaller (via rel_widths + legend text sizing)
#  - R² annotations: placed in UPPER-RIGHT using x = Inf, y = Inf so it works even with flipped axes
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12

pt_size            <- 2.8
pt_alpha           <- 0.85
salvia_ring_size   <- 5
salvia_ring_stroke <- 0.5

# make legend slightly bigger
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")  # longer so dashed is obvious

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w
)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  p_model <- pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_model))
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# Generic panel builder
#   - R² always upper-right with x=Inf, y=Inf (works with flipped axes)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_xy <- function(
  xvar, yvar,
  xlab = NULL, 
  ylab = NULL,
  xscale = NULL, 
  yscale = NULL,
  flip_x = FALSE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
) {

  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)

  sig_with    <- p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)
  sig_without <- p_to_sig_label(st_without$p)

  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df      %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia",    .sig = sig_with),
    q3_df_outs %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = sig_without)
  )

  salvia_df <- q3_df %>% filter(species %in% salvia_spp)

  p <- ggplot() +
    # points
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    # salvia rings
    geom_point(
      data = salvia_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = salvia_ring_size, stroke = salvia_ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # species legend
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 2,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    # regression scales
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Dataset",
      values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance",
      values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) 

  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (flip_x) p <- p + scale_x_reverse()

  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
  }

  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"]
      )
  }

  p
}

# ============================
# Panels A–C: x = P50 (flipped)
# ============================
fig5a <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "min_wp",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = expression(Psi[min]~"(MPa)"),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = FALSE,
  show_y = TRUE
)

fig5b <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "min_lfm",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = "Min. Seasonal LFM (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0),
    labels = c(40, 60, 80, 100)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

fig5c <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "max_lfm",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = "Max. observed LFM (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5),
    labels = c(100, 150, 200, 250)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = TRUE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

# ============================
# Panel D: x = ΨTLP (flipped so more negative on RIGHT), y = max_lfm
#   - same size as others
#   - hide y labels/text (share with C visually)
# ============================
fig5d <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "psi_tlp", yvar = "max_lfm",
  xlab = expression(psi[TLP]~"(MPa)"),
  ylab = "Max. observed LFM (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5),
    labels = c(100, 150, 200, 250)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = TRUE, 
  show_y = FALSE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------
# Legend pulled once (from A), then placed in a dedicated column
# ----------------------------


legend <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(
    cowplot::get_legend(
      fig5a +
        theme(
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.key = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_blank(),
          legend.box.background = element_blank()
        )
    ),
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5,   # center
    width = 1, height = 1,
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5
  )

blank <- cowplot::ggdraw()


# ----------------------------
# Legend (pull once)
# ----------------------------
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  fig5a +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.background = element_blank()
    )
)

# Wrap legend grob in a plot so it behaves like a plot_grid element
legend_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_grob(legend_grob)

# ----------------------------
# Build columns so legend spans A+B region
# ----------------------------

# Left column: (A over B) over C  ==> heights 2:1
left_top <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig5a + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5b + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "l"
)

left_col <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig5a + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5b + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5c + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "l"
)


# Right column: legend over D  ==> heights 2:1
right_col <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend_plot,
  fig5d + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(2, 1)
)

# Combine columns (make plots slightly smaller and legend slightly bigger)
fig_all <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  left_col,
  right_col,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.80)   # ↑ increase this (0.70–0.90) to give legend more room
)

# ----------------------------
# Labels (A,B,C,D) positioned for this new layout
# ----------------------------
# Panel labels (positions tuned for this grid)
fig_all_labeled <- cowplot::ggdraw(fig_all) +
  cowplot::draw_plot_label(
    label = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    x = c(0.11, 0.11, 0.11, 0.58),
    y = c(0.99, 0.66, 0.32, 0.32),
    size = 16,
    fontface = "bold"
  )
fig_all_labeled
```

##Fig. SX. Like 7, but with intercept LFM
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig 7: A–D with equal-size panels and a dedicated legend column
#
# Layout (all panels SAME SIZE):
#   Col 1: A (top), B (mid), C (bottom)   [x = P50, flipped]
#   Col 2: Legend (top spanning A+B), blank (mid), D (bottom) [x = ΨTLP, flipped]
#
# Requests implemented:
#  - ALL PANELS same size (C and D are same size; D matches A/B/C)
#  - Legend slightly bigger; plots slightly smaller (via rel_widths + legend text sizing)
#  - R² annotations: placed in UPPER-RIGHT using x = Inf, y = Inf so it works even with flipped axes
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12

pt_size            <- 2.8
pt_alpha           <- 0.85
salvia_ring_size   <- 5
salvia_ring_stroke <- 0.5

# make legend slightly bigger
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")  # longer so dashed is obvious

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w
)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  p_model <- pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_model))
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# Generic panel builder
#   - R² always upper-right with x=Inf, y=Inf (works with flipped axes)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_xy <- function(
  xvar, yvar,
  xlab = NULL, 
  ylab = NULL,
  xscale = NULL, 
  yscale = NULL,
  flip_x = FALSE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
) {

  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)

  sig_with    <- p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)
  sig_without <- p_to_sig_label(st_without$p)

  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df      %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia",    .sig = sig_with),
    q3_df_outs %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = sig_without)
  )

  salvia_df <- q3_df %>% filter(species %in% salvia_spp)

  p <- ggplot() +
    # points
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    # salvia rings
    geom_point(
      data = salvia_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = salvia_ring_size, stroke = salvia_ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # species legend
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 2,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    # regression scales
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Dataset",
      values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance",
      values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) 

  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (flip_x) p <- p + scale_x_reverse()

  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
  }

  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"]
      )
  }

  p
}

# ============================
# Panels A–C: x = P50 (flipped)
# ============================
fig5a <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "min_wp",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = expression(Psi[min]~"(MPa)"),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = FALSE,
  show_y = TRUE
)

fig5b <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "min_lfm",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = "Min. Seasonal LFM (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0),
    labels = c(40, 60, 80, 100)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

fig5c <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "intercept",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = "LFM intercept (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5),
    labels = c(100, 150, 200, 250)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = TRUE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

# ============================
# Panel D: x = ΨTLP (flipped so more negative on RIGHT), y = max_lfm
#   - same size as others
#   - hide y labels/text (share with C visually)
# ============================
fig5d <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "psi_tlp", yvar = "intercept",
  xlab = expression(psi[TLP]~"(MPa)"),
  ylab = "LFM intercept (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5),
    labels = c(100, 150, 200, 250)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = TRUE, 
  show_y = FALSE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------
# Legend pulled once (from A), then placed in a dedicated column
# ----------------------------


legend <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(
    cowplot::get_legend(
      fig5a +
        theme(
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.key = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_blank(),
          legend.box.background = element_blank()
        )
    ),
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5,   # center
    width = 1, height = 1,
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5
  )

blank <- cowplot::ggdraw()


# ----------------------------
# Legend (pull once)
# ----------------------------
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  fig5a +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.background = element_blank()
    )
)

# Wrap legend grob in a plot so it behaves like a plot_grid element
legend_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_grob(legend_grob)

# ----------------------------
# Build columns so legend spans A+B region
# ----------------------------

# Left column: (A over B) over C  ==> heights 2:1
left_top <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig5a + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5b + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "l"
)

left_col <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig5a + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5b + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  fig5c + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "l"
)


# Right column: legend over D  ==> heights 2:1
right_col <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend_plot,
  fig5d + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(2, 1)
)

# Combine columns (make plots slightly smaller and legend slightly bigger)
fig_all <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  left_col,
  right_col,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.80)   # ↑ increase this (0.70–0.90) to give legend more room
)

# ----------------------------
# Labels (A,B,C,D) positioned for this new layout
# ----------------------------
# Panel labels (positions tuned for this grid)
fig_all_labeled <- cowplot::ggdraw(fig_all) +
  cowplot::draw_plot_label(
    label = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    x = c(0.11, 0.11, 0.11, 0.58),
    y = c(0.99, 0.66, 0.32, 0.32),
    size = 16,
    fontface = "bold"
  )
fig_all_labeled


# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(
  plot = fig_all_labeled,
# filename = here::here("output", "figures", "main", "Fig_07_P50_panels_LFMint.jpg"),  # disabled
  filename = tempfile(fileext = ".jpg"),
  dpi = 600,
  width = 6,
  height = 8
)
```

```{r}
# Settings

salvia_ring_stroke <- 0.5

# make legend slightly bigger
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")  # longer so dashed is obvious

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  p_model <- pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)

}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# Generic panel builder
#   - R² always upper-right with x=Inf, y=Inf (works with flipped axes)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_xy <- function(
  xvar, yvar,
  xlab = NULL, 
  ylab = NULL,
  xscale = NULL, 
  yscale = NULL,
  flip_x = FALSE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
) {

  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)

  sig_with    <- p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)
  sig_without <- p_to_sig_label(st_without$p)

  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df      %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia",    .sig = sig_with),
    q3_df_outs %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = sig_without)
  )

  salvia_df <- q3_df %>% filter(species %in% salvia_spp)

  p <- ggplot() +
    # points
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    # salvia rings
    geom_point(
      data = salvia_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = salvia_ring_size, stroke = salvia_ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # species legend
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 1,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    # regression scales
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df,

}
```

##Fig. SX. Like 7, but with intercept LFM
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig 7: A–D with equal-size panels and a dedicated legend column
#
# Layout (all panels SAME SIZE):
#   Col 1: A (top), B (mid), C (bottom)   [x = P50, flipped]
#   Col 2: Legend (top spanning A+B), blank (mid), D (bottom) [x = ΨTLP, flipped]
#
# Requests implemented:
#  - ALL PANELS same size (C and D are same size; D matches A/B/C)
#  - Legend slightly bigger; plots slightly smaller (via rel_widths + legend text sizing)
#  - R² annotations: placed in UPPER-RIGHT using x = Inf, y = Inf so it works even with flipped axes
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12

pt_size            <- 2.8
pt_alpha           <- 0.85
salvia_ring_size   <- 5
salvia_ring_stroke <- 0.5

# make legend slightly bigger
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")  # longer so dashed is obvious

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w
)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  p_model <- pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_model))
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# Generic panel builder
#   - R² always upper-right with x=Inf, y=Inf (works with flipped axes)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_xy <- function(
  xvar, yvar,
  xlab = NULL, 
  ylab = NULL,
  xscale = NULL, 
  yscale = NULL,
  flip_x = FALSE,
  show_x = FALSE, 
  show_y = TRUE,
  add_r2 = TRUE
) {

  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)

  sig_with    <- p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)
  sig_without <- p_to_sig_label(st_without$p)

  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df      %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia",    .sig = sig_with),
    q3_df_outs %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = sig_without)
  )

  salvia_df <- q3_df %>% filter(species %in% salvia_spp)

  p <- ggplot() +
    # points
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    # salvia rings
    geom_point(
      data = salvia_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = salvia_ring_size, stroke = salvia_ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # species legend
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 2,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    # regression scales
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Dataset",
      values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance",
      values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) 

  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (flip_x) p <- p + scale_x_reverse()

  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
  }

  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"]
      )
  }

  p
}

# ============================
# Panels A–C: x = P50 (flipped)
# ============================
fig5a <- build_panel_xy(
  xvar = "plc50_stem", yvar = "min_wp",
  xlab = "P50 (MPa)", ylab = expression(Psi[min]~"(MPa)"),
  flip_x = TRUE,
  show_x = FALSE,
  show_y = TRUE
)

fig5b <- build_panel_xy(

    breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0),
    labels = c(40, 60, 80, 100)
  ),
  flip_x = TRUE,

  add_r2 = TRUE
)

# ============================

  ),

  show_x = TRUE, 
  show_y = FALSE,

)

# ----------------------------
# Legend pulled once (from A), then placed in a dedicated column
# ----------------------------


legend <- cowplot::ggdraw() +

  )

blank <- cowplot::ggdraw()


# ----------------------------
# Legend (pull once)
# ----------------------------
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  fig5a +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.background = element_blank()

)

# Wrap legend grob in a plot so it behaves like a plot_grid element
legend_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_grob(legend_grob)

# ----------------------------
# Build columns so legend spans A+B region
# ----------------------------

# Left column: (A over B) over C  ==> heights 2:1
left_top <- cowplot::plot_grid(

left_col <- cowplot::plot_grid(

# Combine columns (make plots slightly smaller and legend slightly bigger)
```

#Fig 8: SLA and LDMC, intercept

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig: Traits vs model params (LDMC + SLA layout, legend in top-right)
#
# Layout:
#   Row 1:  A = LFMmin ~ LDMC      |  Legend (pulled from B)
#   Row 2:  B = Intercept (%) ~ LDMC  |  C = Intercept (%) ~ SLA
#   Row 3:  D = Slope ~ LDMC       |  E = Slope ~ SLA
#
# Includes:
#  - one-reg panels (A, D, E): single lm on q3_df
#  - two-reg panels (B, C): lm on q3_df (with) and q3_df_outs (without)
#  - rings only for salvias in intercept panels
#  - F-test table includes R2, p-value, and df1/df2
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# Data: intercept as percent
# ----------------------------
q3_df <- q3_df %>%
  mutate(intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100)

q3_df_outs <- q3_df_outs %>%
  mutate(intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100)

# ----------------------------
# Settings (match Fig 7 style)
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12

pt_size      <- 2.8
pt_alpha     <- 0.85
ring_size    <- 5
ring_stroke  <- 0.5

legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w,
  panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt") 
)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------


get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f  <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  df1   <- unname(fstat[2])
  df2   <- unname(fstat[3])
  p_mod <- pf(unname(fstat[1]), df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  list(
    r2  = unname(sm$r.squared),
    p   = unname(p_mod),
    df1 = df1,
    df2 = df2
  )
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# Panel builder: ONE regression (all data; q3_df)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_one_reg <- function(
    xvar, yvar,
    ring_spp = NULL,
    xlab = NULL, 
    ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, 
    yscale = NULL,
    show_x = FALSE, 
    show_y = TRUE,
    add_r2 = TRUE,
    line_type = "solid"  # "dashed" when the regression is not significant
) {
  st_all <- get_model_stats(q3_df, yvar, xvar)
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) q3_df[0, ] else q3_df %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "Functional type",
      values = c(angiosperm = 16, gymnosperm = 17),
      labels = c(angiosperm = "Angiosperm", gymnosperm = "Gymnosperm"),
      guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1), order = 4)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 3,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1),
        order = 1
      )
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]]),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.95, color = "black", linetype = line_type
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) +theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  
  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_all$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4,
        color = "black"
      )
  }
  
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# Panel builder: TWO regressions (with vs without salvias)
# ----------------------------
build_panel_two_regs <- function(
    xvar, yvar,
    ring_spp = NULL,
    xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL,
    show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE,
    add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)
  
  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df %>%
      mutate(
        .reg_group = "With Salvia",
        .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)
      ),
    q3_df_outs %>%
      mutate(
        .reg_group = "Without Salvia",
        .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_without$p)
      )
  )
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) q3_df[0, ] else q3_df %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "Functional type",
      values = c(angiosperm = 16, gymnosperm = 17),
      labels = c(angiosperm = "Angiosperm", gymnosperm = "Gymnosperm"),
      guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1), order = 4)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA,
      size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Species",
        ncol = 3,
        override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1),
        order = 1
      )
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Regression",
      values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25), order = 2)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance",
      values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = "none"  # solid vs dashed is explained in the caption
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
      y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) +theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  
  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  if (!show_y) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf, y = Inf,
        label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)),
        hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4,
        color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"]
      )
  }
  
  p
}

# ============================================================
# Panels (LDMC + SLA layout)
# ============================================================

# LFMmin ~ LDMC is significant only without the Salvias, so show both fits as in B-C
figA <- build_panel_two_regs(
  xvar = "ldmc",
  yvar = "min_lfm",
  ring_spp = salvia_spp,
  xlab = "LDMC (g g⁻¹)",
  ylab = "LFMmin (%)",
  yscale = scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0),
    labels = c(40, 60, 80, 100)
  ),
```

##Fig 8 v2 (unused): Shape by f group, remove significance legend:


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig: Traits vs model params (LDMC + SLA layout, legend in top-right)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(readr)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# 1. Data & Functional Type Updates (Using your exact case_when)
# ----------------------------
q3_df <- read_csv(here("data", "q3_df.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm", 
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    )
  )

q3_df_outs <- q3_df_outs %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm", 
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 2. Assign Shapes to Species
# ----------------------------
# This guarantees every species gets the correct shape. 
# Because we map this to `shape = species`, the color legend will inherit these!
all_spp <- sort(unique(c(as.character(q3_df$species), as.character(q3_df_outs$species))))

spp_shapes_named <- sapply(all_spp, function(s) {
  ft <- q3_df$functional_type[q3_df$species == s][1]
  if (is.na(ft)) ft <- q3_df_outs$functional_type[q3_df_outs$species == s][1]
  if (!is.na(ft) && ft == "Gymnosperm") 17 else 16
})

# ----------------------------
# 3. Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12
pt_size      <- 2.8
pt_alpha     <- 0.85
ring_size    <- 5
ring_stroke  <- 0.5
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w,
  panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt") 
)

# ----------------------------
# 4. Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f  <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  df1   <- unname(fstat[2])
  df2   <- unname(fstat[3])
  p_mod <- pf(unname(fstat[1]), df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_mod), df1 = df1, df2 = df2)
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# 5. Panel builder: ONE regression
# ----------------------------
build_panel_one_reg <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  st_all <- get_model_stats(q3_df, yvar, xvar)
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) q3_df[0, ] else q3_df %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # 1. Map both Color and Shape to Species (Automatically puts shapes in the color legend)
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species, shape = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = spp_shapes_named, guide = "none") + # Hide standalone shape legend
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(title = "Species", ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1), order = 1)
    ) +
    # 2. Reset the shape scale to build the independent "Plant Group" Legend
    ggnewscale::new_scale("shape") +
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], shape = functional_type),
      alpha = 0, size = 0 # Invisible points just to trigger the legend
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "Plant Group",
      values = c("Gymnosperm" = 17, "Angiosperm" = 16),
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1, color = "black"), order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = q3_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]]),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95, color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  if (add_r2) p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_all$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = "black")
  
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 6. Panel builder: TWO regressions
# ----------------------------
build_panel_two_regs <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  st_with    <- get_model_stats(q3_df,      yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(q3_df_outs, yvar, xvar)
  
  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    q3_df %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)),
    q3_df_outs %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_without$p))
  )
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) q3_df[0, ] else q3_df %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # 1. Map both Color and Shape to Species 
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species, shape = species),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = species),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = spp_shapes_named, guide = "none") +
    color_species +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(title = "Species", ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1), order = 1)
    ) +
    # 2. Reset the shape scale to build the independent "Plant Group" Legend
    ggnewscale::new_scale("shape") +
    geom_point(
      data = q3_df,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], shape = functional_type),
      alpha = 0, size = 0 
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "Plant Group",
      values = c("Gymnosperm" = 17, "Angiosperm" = 16),
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1, color = "black"), order = 2, ncol = 2)
    ) +
    # 3. Reset color scale for regressions
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Regression", values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25), order = 3)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance", values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = "none" # Completely removes the significance linetype legend
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4, color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"])
  }

  p
}

# ============================================================
# 7. Build Panels
# ============================================================
figA <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="ldmc", yvar="min_lfm", xlab="LDMC (g/g)", ylab="LFMmin (%)", yscale=scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0), labels=c(40, 60, 80, 100)), show_x=FALSE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figB <- build_panel_two_regs(xvar="ldmc", yvar="intercept_lfm_pct", ring_spp=salvia_spp, xlab="LDMC (g/g)", ylab="LFMmax (%)", show_x=FALSE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figC <- build_panel_two_regs(xvar="sla", yvar="intercept_lfm_pct", ring_spp=salvia_spp, xlab="SLA (mm2/mg)", ylab="LFMmax (%)", show_x=FALSE, show_y=FALSE, add_r2=F)
figD <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="ldmc", yvar="slope", xlab="LDMC (g/g)", ylab="Slope", show_x=TRUE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figE <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="sla", yvar="slope", xlab="SLA (mm2/mg)", ylab="Slope", show_x=TRUE, show_y=FALSE, add_r2=F)

# ============================================================
# 8. Patchwork Layout
# ============================================================
library(patchwork)
library(ggnewscale)

# Extract the completely populated legend from figB 
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  figB + theme(
    legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical", legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(), legend.box.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"), legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0, "cm"), legend.box.margin = margin(3,3,3,3)
  )
)
legend_plot <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = legend_grob) & theme(plot.tag = element_blank())

# Strip legends from individual panels
zero <- theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(3,3,3,3))
A0 <- figA + zero
B0 <- figB + zero
C0 <- figC + zero + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "transparent"), axis.title.y = element_text(color = "transparent"))
D0 <- figD + zero
E0 <- figE + zero + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "transparent"), axis.title.y = element_text(color = "transparent"))

# Add tags
tag_theme <- theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16), plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98))
A1 <- A0 + labs(tag = "A") + tag_theme
B1 <- B0 + labs(tag = "B") + tag_theme
C1 <- C0 + labs(tag = "C") + tag_theme
D1 <- D0 + labs(tag = "D") + tag_theme
E1 <- E0 + labs(tag = "E") + tag_theme

p_final <- (A1 | legend_plot) / (B1 | C1) / (D1 | E1) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(.8, 1), heights = c(1, 1, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(3,3,3,3), panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

p_final

ggsave(filename = here::here("output", "figures", "SI", "unused_traits_by_ftype.jpg"), plot = p_final, dpi = 600, width = 6, height = 8)
```

###Unused (was Fig S11, then S10): Growth form

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig: Traits vs model params (LDMC + SLA layout, legend in top-right)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(readr)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# 1. Data, Functional Type, & Growth Form Updates
# ----------------------------
q3_df <- q3_df %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm", 
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    ),
    # Clean up growth_form text so it looks nice in the legend
    growth_form = case_when(
      tolower(growth_form) == "tree" ~ "Tree",
      tolower(growth_form) == "shrub" ~ "Shrub",
      TRUE ~ as.character(growth_form)
    )
  )

q3_df_outs <- q3_df_outs %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm", 
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    ),
    growth_form = case_when(
      tolower(growth_form) == "tree" ~ "Tree",
      tolower(growth_form) == "shrub" ~ "Shrub",
      TRUE ~ as.character(growth_form)
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 2. Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

# Colors for Growth Form (Colorblind-friendly palette)
gf_colors <- c(
  "Tree"  = "#0072B2",   # Blue
  "Shrub" = "#D55E00"    # Vermillion/Orange
)

# Shapes for Plant Group
ft_shapes <- c(
  "Gymnosperm"    = 17,     # Solid triangle
  "Angiosperm" = 16      # Solid circle
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12
pt_size      <- 2.8
pt_alpha     <- 0.85
ring_size    <- 5
ring_stroke  <- 0.5
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w,
  panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt") 
)

# ----------------------------
# 3. Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f  <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  df1   <- unname(fstat[2])
  df2   <- unname(fstat[3])
  p_mod <- pf(unname(fstat[1]), df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_mod), df1 = df1, df2 = df2)
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# 4. Panel builder: ONE regression
# ----------------------------
build_panel_one_reg <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  # Clean NAs
  df_clean <- q3_df[!is.na(q3_df[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df[[yvar]]), ]
  
  st_all <- get_model_stats(df_clean, yvar, xvar)
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) df_clean[0, ] else df_clean %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_clean,
      # Map Color directly to Growth Form, Shape directly to Functional Type!
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = growth_form, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = growth_form),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Plant Group", values = ft_shapes) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Growth Form", values = gf_colors) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_clean, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]]),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95, color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_all$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = "black")
  
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 5. Panel builder: TWO regressions
# ----------------------------
build_panel_two_regs <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  # Clean NAs
  df_clean <- q3_df[!is.na(q3_df[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df[[yvar]]), ]
  outs_clean <- q3_df_outs[!is.na(q3_df_outs[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df_outs[[yvar]]), ]
  
  st_with    <- get_model_stats(df_clean, yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(outs_clean, yvar, xvar)
  
  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    df_clean %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)),
    outs_clean %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_without$p))
  )
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) df_clean[0, ] else df_clean %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_clean,
      # Map Color directly to Growth Form, Shape directly to Functional Type!
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = growth_form, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = growth_form),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Plant Group", values = ft_shapes) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Growth Form", values = gf_colors) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Regression", values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25), order = 3)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance", values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = "none" # Completely removes linetype legend
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4, color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"])
  }

  p
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Build Panels
# ============================================================

figA <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="ldmc", yvar="min_lfm", xlab="LDMC", ylab="LFMmin (%)", yscale=scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0), labels=c(40, 60, 80, 100)), show_x=FALSE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figB <- build_panel_two_regs(xvar="ldmc", yvar="intercept_lfm_pct", ring_spp=salvia_spp, xlab="LDMC", ylab="LFMmax (%)", show_x=FALSE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figC <- build_panel_two_regs(xvar="sla", yvar="intercept_lfm_pct", ring_spp=salvia_spp, xlab="SLA", ylab="LFMmax (%)", show_x=FALSE, show_y=FALSE, add_r2=F)
figD <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="ldmc", yvar="slope", xlab="LDMC", ylab="Slope", show_x=TRUE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
figE <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="sla", yvar="slope", xlab="SLA", ylab="Slope", show_x=TRUE, show_y=FALSE, add_r2=F)

# ============================================================
# 7. Patchwork Layout

# Extract the natively built legend from figB

    legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 8),

    legend.key.width = unit(0, "cm"), legend.box.margin = margin(3,3,3,3)
  )
)

# Strip legends from individual panels
zero <- theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(3,3,3,3))
A0 <- figA + zero

A1 <- A0 + labs(tag = "A") + tag_theme
B1 <- B0 + labs(tag = "B") + tag_theme
C1 <- C0 + labs(tag = "C") + tag_theme
D1 <- D0 + labs(tag = "D") + tag_theme
E1 <- E0 + labs(tag = "E") + tag_theme

p_final
```

###Unused (was Fig S10, then S9). Leaf habit: 

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fig: Traits vs model params (LDMC + SLA layout, legend in top-right)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(readr)
library(here)

if (!requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggnewscale: install.packages('ggnewscale')")
}

# ----------------------------
# 1. Data, Functional Type, & Leaf Habit Updates
# ----------------------------
q3_df <- q3_df %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm", 
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    ),
    # Evergreen / winter- / drought-deciduous (defined in 00_figure_setup.R)
    leaf_habit = leaf_habit_class(species)
  )

q3_df_outs <- q3_df_outs %>%
  mutate(
    intercept_lfm_pct = intercept_lfm * 100,
    functional_type = case_when(
      functional_type %in% c("gymnosperm") ~ "Gymnosperm",
      TRUE ~ as.character("Angiosperm")
    ),
    leaf_habit = leaf_habit_class(species)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 2. Settings
# ----------------------------
salvia_spp <- c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")

reg_colors <- c(
  "With Salvia"    = "darkgrey",
  "Without Salvia" = "black"
)

sig_linetypes <- c(
  "p < 0.05" = "solid",
  "p ≥ 0.05" = "dashed"
)

# Colors for Leaf Habit (Colorblind-friendly palette, defined in 00_figure_setup.R)
lh_colors <- color_leaf_habit

# Shapes for Plant Group
ft_shapes <- c(
  "Gymnosperm"    = 17,     # Solid triangle
  "Angiosperm" = 16      # Solid circle
)

axis_title_size <- 14
axis_text_size  <- 12
pt_size      <- 2.8
pt_alpha     <- 0.85
ring_size    <- 5
ring_stroke  <- 0.5
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size  <- 11
legend_key_h      <- unit(0.36, "cm")
legend_key_w      <- unit(1.2, "cm")

base_theme <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
  axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
  legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
  legend.key.height = legend_key_h,
  legend.key.width  = legend_key_w,
  panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt") 
)

# ----------------------------
# 3. Helpers
# ----------------------------
get_model_stats <- function(df, yvar, xvar) {
  f  <- as.formula(paste0(yvar, " ~ ", xvar))
  sm <- summary(lm(f, data = df))
  fstat <- sm$fstatistic
  df1   <- unname(fstat[2])
  df2   <- unname(fstat[3])
  p_mod <- pf(unname(fstat[1]), df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  list(r2 = unname(sm$r.squared), p = unname(p_mod), df1 = df1, df2 = df2)
}

p_to_sig_label <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) || p >= 0.05, "p ≥ 0.05", "p < 0.05")
}

# ----------------------------
# 4. Panel builder: ONE regression
# ----------------------------
build_panel_one_reg <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  # Clean NAs for traits AND for leaf_habit so we don't drop points unexpectedly!
  df_clean <- q3_df[!is.na(q3_df[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df[[yvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df$leaf_habit), ]
  
  st_all <- get_model_stats(df_clean, yvar, xvar)
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) df_clean[0, ] else df_clean %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_clean,
      # Map Color to Leaf Habit, Shape to Functional Type
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = leaf_habit, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = leaf_habit),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Plant Group", values = ft_shapes) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Leaf Habit", values = lh_colors, breaks = names(lh_colors)) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      data = df_clean, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]]),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95, color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_all$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = "black")
  
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 5. Panel builder: TWO regressions
# ----------------------------
build_panel_two_regs <- function(

  st_with    <- get_model_stats(df_clean, yvar, xvar)

  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    df_clean %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)),

  )
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) df_clean[0, ] else df_clean %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_clean,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = leaf_habit, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = leaf_habit),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Plant Group", values = ft_shapes) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Leaf Habit", values = lh_colors, breaks = names(lh_colors)) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Regression", values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25), order = 3)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance", values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4, color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"])
  }

  p
}
```

```{r}
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_all$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = "black")
  
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 5. Panel builder: TWO regressions
# ----------------------------
build_panel_two_regs <- function(
    xvar, yvar, ring_spp = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,
    xscale = NULL, yscale = NULL, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE, add_r2 = TRUE
) {
  df_clean <- q3_df[!is.na(q3_df[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df[[yvar]]), ]
  outs_clean <- q3_df_outs[!is.na(q3_df_outs[[xvar]]) & !is.na(q3_df_outs[[yvar]]), ]
  
  st_with    <- get_model_stats(df_clean, yvar, xvar)
  st_without <- get_model_stats(outs_clean, yvar, xvar)
  
  reg_df <- bind_rows(
    df_clean %>% mutate(.reg_group = "With Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_with$p)),
    outs_clean %>% mutate(.reg_group = "Without Salvia", .sig = p_to_sig_label(st_without$p))
  )
  
  ring_df <- if (is.null(ring_spp)) df_clean[0, ] else df_clean %>% filter(species %in% ring_spp)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_clean,
      aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = genus, shape = functional_type),
      size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ring_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = genus),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, size = ring_size, stroke = ring_stroke, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Plant Group", values = ft_shapes) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(title = "Genus", ncol = 3, order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3.8, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_smooth(
      data = reg_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], color = .reg_group, linetype = .sig),
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Regression", values = reg_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.25), order = 3)
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Significance", values = sig_linetypes,
      guide = "none" # Completely removes linetype legend
    ) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL, y = if (show_y) ylab else NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none") 
  
  if (!is.null(xscale)) p <- p + xscale
  if (!is.null(yscale)) p <- p + yscale
  if (!show_x) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  
  if (add_r2) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R2 (with) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_with$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.25, size = 4, color = reg_colors["With Salvia"]) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R2 (without) = ", sprintf("%.2f", st_without$r2)), hjust = 1.02, vjust = 2.55, size = 4, color = reg_colors["Without Salvia"])
  }

  p
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Build Panels
# ============================================================

figA <- build_panel_one_reg(xvar="ldmc", yvar="min_lfm", xlab="LDMC", ylab="LFMmin (%)", yscale=scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0), labels=c(40, 60, 80, 100)), show_x=FALSE, show_y=TRUE, add_r2=F)
```
